items.docs: The PUT operation on the /user/helpflags/{flag_id} endpoint in Grafana allows authenticated users to set or update a specific help flag identified by the flag_id parameter in the URL path. Help flags are typically used to track which help tooltips, tutorials, or onboarding messages a user has already seen or dismissed within the Grafana interface, enabling a personalized user experience by preventing repetitive display of guidance elements.
